meta.description: A grammaticality judgment task on French and Spanish clusters of a dative and a third-person accusative clitic, crossing whether the accusative clitic's antecedent c-commands it, whether that antecedent is a logophoric center, and the person of the dative clitic, which in one condition is a third person bound by a quantifier. Ratings were given on a continuous scale, between subjects, against control sentences with a full noun phrase as indirect object. Locators are to the pages of the authors' accepted manuscript in Harvard's DASH repository.
